body.x: With the support from Daegu TechnoparkMobile Convergence Center, WooKyoung Information Technology (CEO Park Yun-ha)will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 openingin Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its AI-based face recognition and imageinformation protection system by using big data.

WooKyoung Information Technology focuses its core competencies on H/W, S/W, service, and solution, which are the foundation of IT field, and secures original technologies in information security and atypical data security. With this, the company provides the optimal consulting and solution for government, public institutions, schools and hospitals.
Secuwatcher for CCTV is the most secure video information security solution to prevent video leakage and forgery and alteration.

Secuwatcher for CCTV is a professionalvideo information security system consisting of CCTV video security storage(encryption module) system and safe online video export system for personalprivacy protection based on personal information protection act.
Also, it enables high-speed encryption anddecryption of high-quality large-size images and provides only the necessaryinformation according to access rights.

The CEO said, "The company's goal isto analyze the various data occurring in the city and provide data such astraffic, disaster, safety, and environment as a service for citizens' smartlives. We have acquired 46 channels in Korea, and is actively performingmarketing activities in Europe, the Middle East and Malaysia.”

Daegu Metropolitan City has supported 196 ICT venture companies and SMEs in the area to enter the market for eight consecutive years since 2013, with the cumulative contract amount of $22.4 million as of 2019.

Daegu Joint Pavilion, organized by Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center, will have 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups. Major programs include exhibitions, investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES review conferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to run joint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilion has been set up in CES 2020. The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
